meta.name: youtube-transcript
meta.description: Extract YouTube video transcripts with metadata and save as Markdown to Obsidian vault. Use this skill when the user requests downloading YouTube transcripts, converting YouTube videos to text, or extracting video subtitles. Does not download video/audio files, only metadata and subtitles.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取YouTube视频字幕并保存为Markdown笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将YouTube视频字幕保存到Obsidian笔记库
copy.tagline_en: Extract YouTube video transcripts and save as Markdown notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to save YouTube video subtitles into your Obsidian vault

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以提取 YouTube 视频的字幕和元数据（标题、频道、时长等），并保存为 Markdown 文件到 Obsidian 笔记库。
howto.when: 当你要求下载 YouTube 字幕、把视频转成文字或提取视频字幕时触发。

say.note: Claude 会生成带时间戳的文本。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can extract YouTube video transcripts and metadata (title, channel, duration, etc.) and save them as Markdown files to an Obsidian vault.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to download a YouTube transcript, convert a video to text, or extract subtitles.

say_en.text: Extract the transcript for this YouTube video: https://youtu.be/abc123
say_en.note: Claude will extract subtitles and save to Obsidian.

say_en.text: Convert this video to text: https://youtu.be/xyz789
